text:
sara: Heads-up — planning a tenant_id type migration (bigint -> uuid) on shard-3 during the 03/28 02:00-03:00 UTC change window. Need guardrails: traffic-splitting, per-tenant canary, and a clear rollback/escape hatch if locks spike. Thoughts?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot queued migration job rb-mig-20250328-02-sh3 for 1738204567. Will emit status updates here.

mike: Can we do app-layer traffic-splitting? start 5% -> new schema variant capped at 100 req/min. Also recommend pinning server image to 1.12.3 for the window. :eyes:

owen: +1 pin. Add a DB holdpoint after schema apply and before PK swap step. If any rename or exclusive lock exceeds 10s, abort.

nneka: Backfill is row-based and will have a long tail. Propose per-tenant rate limiter and read-replica warmup before we increase traffic. I'll add throttling config to infra.

sara: Runbook snippet (dropping into thread): ```sql
BEGIN;
ALTER TABLE tenants ADD COLUMN tenant_uuid uuid;
-- backfill runs in job queue, per-tenant batches
UPDATE tenants SET tenant_uuid = gen_random_uuid() WHERE tenant_uuid IS NULL;
-- after backfill: prepare PK swap steps (see below)
COMMIT;
```

owen: Suggestion: avoid two-phase commit. Create new table + copy in batches, then swap via rename under a short exclusive lock (<1s). That keeps rollback simpler.

mike: Fallback plan: if rename wait > 30s, undo rename and resume copy. Add metric `rename.wait_ms` and an alarm. Also pin migration tool to 0.9.2.

infra-oncall: @sara @mike I'm oncall for that window. Deploy-bot: please ensure run rb-mig has `holdpoint` tags and manual abort/continue toggle.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: run rb-mig-20250328-02-sh3 created. Canary tenants: [101..150]. Traffic split schedule: 5% -> 25% -> 50% if no errors for 15m at each step. Will post step completions.

nneka: :thumbsup: I'll ensure backfill jobs use exponential backoff + jitter so canary tenants don't spike the copy queue.

sara: Release notes: callout for downstream services — tenant_id is now string/uuid in some responses. I'll draft the blurb and ping API owners for contract acceptance.

emily: Add a migration progress webhook to #eng-oncall and a short-lived dashboard for rename.wait / lock_time / backfill-rate.

owen: Final checklist (to confirm): pin app image=1.12.3, pin migration tool=0.9.2, read-replica warmup=true, circuit-breaker threshold=5s, rename timeout=30s, abort-on-lock=true, canary tenants configured.

sara: I'll update the runbook with those flags and include `--manual-continue` for each stage. Will also add the release-note draft.

mike: LGTM, will be watching the deploy and the alarms.
